paper.title_en: Quantum-correlation of neutral charmed mesons at BESIII
paper.abstract_en: Quantum-correlated $D\bar D$ pairs give direct access to the strong-phase differences between $D^0$ and $\bar D^0$ decays, which are essential inputs to the CKM angle $γ$ and charm mixing. The BESIII experiment has accumulated the largest data sample at the $ψ(3770)$ resonance, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of $20.3\,\text{fb}^{-1}$. The neutral $D\bar D$ pairs produced at $ψ(3770)$ are in a $C$-odd state. We report new and improved measurements of the strong-phase differences in $D\rightarrow K_{S,L}π^+π^-$, $D\rightarrow K^+K^-π^+π^-$, $D\rightarrow K^-π^+π^+π^-$ and $D\rightarrow K^-π^+π^0$ decays, alongside a measurement of the $CP$-even fraction in $D\rightarrow K^+K^-π^+π^-$. Furthermore, we present a novel method that studies the $D\bar D$ quantum correlations using data collected at centre-of-mass energies from $4.13$ to $4.23\,$GeV, where the $D\bar D$ pairs are produced in $C$-even or $C$-odd states, according to the number of accompanying photons. This gives the first observation of $C$-even $D\bar D$ pairs and a new measurement of the strong-phase difference in $D\rightarrow K^-π^+$ decays.
